motions.item_title: A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving a Professional Services Agreement with Economic & Planning Systems, Inc. for Consulting Related to Eagle's Landing. This item relates to Item 17.A. No formal discussion took place, as the applicant had addressed questions during the previous item. This item pertains to the City’s evaluation of a large regional commercial project along Pony Express Parkway, just north of the downtown area. The project is anticipated to utilize a TIF bond to finance off -site infrastructure, which requires a market study to evaluate factors such as absorption potential and market demand. In consultation with LRB Public Finance Advisors, Eco nomic & Planning Systems, Inc. (EPS) was selected to conduct the study, which is expected to take 1–3 months to complete.
motions.motion: Councilmember Whiting moved to adopt a Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving a Professional Services Agreement with Economic & Planning Systems, Inc. for Consulting Related to Eagle's Landing . Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Hire consultant to study Eagle's Landing market
motions.summary: The city hired Economic & Planning Systems for a one-to-three-month market study of Eagle's Landing, a large commercial project planned along Pony Express Parkway.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah Approving the Development Agreement with Williams .
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to adopt a n Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah , approving the Development Agreement with Will -Power UT, LLC, conditioned on the following amendments to the agreement being made: 1. Clarify that only simple cycle natural gas technology may be used; and 2. Amend the additional property section to limit its use to the Stadion LLC parcel subject to the development agreement approved in October 2025; and 3. Amend the Timing and Rate of Development Section to require that the Generation Project be operational within five (5) years of the effective date of the agreement with the possibility of requesting an extension; and 4. That trees be planted along Pony Express Parkway in compliance with Eagle Mountain Municipal Code 16.35.080 . Councilmember Whiting seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Approve gas power plant deal, with conditions
motions.summary: The city approved a development agreement for a natural gas generation project, requiring simple-cycle technology, operation within five years, and trees along Pony Express Parkway.
